bible_verses.english: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassions don’t fail. They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your steadfast love and mercies that never come to an end. Even when my circumstances change, Your faithfulness remains constant from generation to generation. Fill my heart with joy and put a song of praise on my lips today. May my words and my life make Your goodness known to everyone around me. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your steadfast love and mercies that never come to an end. devotional.reflection_english: God’s mercies are not temporary blessings; they are the enduring foundation of our lives. When we sing of His goodness, we do more than express personal gratitude—we pass down a vibrant testimony of His faithfulness to those who come after us. No matter what season you find yourself in today, choosing to declare His love anchors your heart in His unchanging grace. Let this simple song remind you that His mercies are new every morning, inviting you to praise Him forever.
